此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种称为“灵能光环”的能量流，由于其来源还未理论上确证，我们还不能确定其是否构成威胁。

texts.en:
Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Termed 'Psionic Auras', on the basis of unconfirmed theories about their sources, we have yet to confirm whether they pose a threat or not.

Such an Aura has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system, which might encroach within our borders if it continues to spread.

texts.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

label.zh: 我们很快就会知道它有什么作用了。
label.en: We might know their effects soon enough.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 由于我们与[fromfrom.GetName]的关系[GetLessThanRivalAdj]良好，我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: Given our [GetLessThanRivalAdj]favorable relations with the [fromfrom.GetName], we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

texts.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

summary.text:
# 灵能光环逼近 / Psionic Aura Approaches

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/shroud_events.txt:9122-9251 (4190/4191/4195)`; `common/scripted_effects/psionic_auras_scripted_effects.txt:250-302`; `common/patrons/psionic_auras/00_auras.txt (on_start → check_psionic_suppression_eligibility)`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

任何非“终末”灵能光环开始（光环 on_start 调用 check_psionic_suppression_eligibility）时，光环所在或相邻星系的拥有者若尚未遭遇过灵能光环，就会收到此事件（has_encountered_psionic_auras 只设一次）。

When any non-End psionic aura starts (aura on_start → check_psionic_suppression_eligibility), owners of the aura system or neighbouring systems who have never encountered an aura get this event (has_encountered_psionic_auras, once).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

非灵能帝国看到 4190：科学家描述跨星系蔓延的未知能量流；若已与灵督城邦通讯，追加一段说明城邦可能知道对策。灵能飞升帝国看到 4191：灵能者辨认出光环来自哪个帝国，并按双方关系判断其影响是有利还是有害。

Non-psionic empires see 4190: scientists describe spreading energy flows; if in contact with the Mindwarden Enclave an extra paragraph says it may know countermeasures. Psionic-ascended empires see 4191: telepaths identify the emitting empire and judge from relations whether its effects will be favourable or harmful.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

4190 的选项在存在未接触的灵督城邦时，15天后自动与它建立联系（隐藏 4195），把玩家引向灵督城邦的服务。4191 只有一个确认选项，文字按有机/非格式塔与是否敌对而不同。

4190's option establishes contact with an uncontacted Mindwarden Enclave 15 days later (hidden 4195), leading to the enclave's services. 4191 has one acknowledgement whose wording depends on organic/non-gestalt and hostility.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

4191 的正文按是否已与光环来源通讯、是否知晓光环（power_of_will）以及双方关系变化。

4191 varies by communications with the emitter, knowledge of auras (power_of_will) and relations.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

修正：4190 与 4191 是同一触发的互斥版本，原草稿分为两张卡；现合并为一个故事并加互斥组。

Correction: 4190 and 4191 are exclusive variants of one trigger, split into two cards in the draft; merged with an exclusive group.
